newsitem.title: USA: Shared Technologies stake upped by Cramer.
newsitem.headline: Shared Technologies stake upped by Cramer.

text.p: A group led by New York investor James Cramer said Tuesday it raised its stake in Shared Technologies Fairchild Inc to 994,100 common shares or 6.6 percent from 5.1 percent previously held.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include the purchase of 219,000 common shares between March 5 and March 20 at prices ranging from $5.25 to $7.375 per share.
The group holds the stake for investment purposes.
Shared Technologies Fairchild, based in Wethersfield, Conn., provides building-wide telecommunications services throughout the United States.
